title: Staking Course Design
tagline: Online free education is a very powerful tool but how many people use it?
description:
The project creates a new way to build courses that coordinate between different users (course creators and students) and provide the incentives for users to complete online courses and makes it fun for both the parties. 
Using the superpowers of crypto for education. The goal is so that anyone can come and create the course structure for a new course.
how_its_made: The project creates a marketplace for course creators to create smart contract based courses. The main component is  a contract factory that deploys contracts for the course creators: the course contract and the ERC721 contract for issuing nft badges. The project is built from Scaffold-ETH.
